deliverable_scope: WP-P35-01 — persistence and tenant-scoped session layer (D-01..D-05)
anchor_provenance: emitted by `python tools/check_evidence_anchors.py --emit`; not transcribed by an agent (EBIV R3)

execution_environment.note: Dedicated verification cluster, separate from the unidentified server on 5432. Binds loopback only.
execution_environment.why_this_matters: A superuser or table owner bypasses Row-Level Security. Had bopen_app held either property, every passing result below would be worthless. Verified directly against pg_roles and pg_tables.

test_results.note: Pass count is an input to admissibility, not a verdict (EBIV §4). The mutation probes below are what establish that these assertions can fail.

detail.R1: All isolation assertions execute SQL against PostgreSQL 17.10 with migrations 001-003 applied. No Python data structure substitutes for a policy.
detail.R2: invariant-traceability.csv names a test ID for every invariant in scope.
detail.R3: commit_oid and tree_oid emitted by tool from git.
detail.R4: Cross-tenant read, cross-tenant write, unset context, unknown tenant, audit mutation, and four database constraints each carry a negative probe. Three schema mutations recorded in mutation-probes.json.
detail.R5: With BOPEN_DATABASE_URL unset the isolation suite fails rather than skipping; verified before the database was provisioned.

admissibility_self_assessment.caveat: This is the Maker's self-assessment. Under EBIV §3 it carries no verdict weight. It is recorded so a verifier can check the claim rather than reconstruct it.

acceptance_criteria.A-06_migration_reversible: NOT MET — 003 was applied forward against a database already carrying 001 and 002, but the rollback script was never executed. Recorded as unmet rather than assumed.

roles.quorum_note: EBIV §6.1 requires a minimum of two verifiers to realize a confirmation. Claude authored this work package and is disqualified under §3. Handoff issued at docs/00-governance/handoffs/HANDOFF-P35-PARALLEL-TO-CODEX.md.

known_gaps: A-06 unmet: migration 003 rollback not executed.

Mutation A (dropping tenant_isolation_resources) is detected, but as 13 setUp errors rather than one named assertion failure, because the seed INSERT is itself refused when RLS is enabled with no policy present. Detection holds; legibility is weaker than mutations B and C.
Findings F-4 through F-7 of the Phase 3 review remain open. They are entitlement-module defects outside WP-P35-01 scope and are not addressed here.
Migrations 001 and 002 have no rollback scripts, contrary to AGENTS.md §14. Pre-existing; not corrected by this work package.
